method: Every remaining fixture is played out with the model's home/draw/away probabilities (the published prediction where there is one, otherwise the model without odds) and a score drawn from its expected goals. Ranked on points, goal difference, goals scored. Point deductions and head-to-head tie-breakers are not modelled.
notice: Probabilities, not certainties. For information and entertainment only.
